dataset_metadata.name: Comprehensive battery aging dataset: capacity and impedance fade measurements of a lithium-ion NMC/C-SiO cell
dataset_metadata.citation: Luh, M. & Blank, T. Comprehensive battery aging dataset: capacity and impedance fade measurements of a lithium-ion NMC/C-SiO cell. Scientific Data 11, 1004 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03831-x
dataset_metadata.funding: German Research Foundation (DFG), Research Training Group 2153 'Energy Status Data - Informatics Methods for its Collection, Analysis and Exploitation'

cell_info.cell_notes: Anode is graphite with silicon oxide (SiO). Cathode chemistry described as H-NMC (LiNixMnyCo1-x-yO2). Allowed voltage range 2.0-4.2 V; used voltage range 2.5-4.2 V. Maximal charging current 6.0 A, discharging current 20.0 A. Temperature range: -5 to +75 C (operation), -5 to +50 C (charging). Energy density 640 Wh/l stated in datasheet.

aging_modes.notes: 16 calendar aging parameter sets (48 cells), 48 cyclic aging parameter sets (144 cells), 12 profile aging parameter sets (36 cells). EOL criterion: estimated usable capacity below 40% of nominal capacity during regular cycling, or below 50% of nominal capacity in check-up. Three cells per parameter set throughout.

time_protocol.test_equipment: Custom battery cycling and measurement acquisition boards (19 cycler boards, each controlling 12 cells); custom-built test bench with DC/DC converters, Raspberry Pi computers, InfluxDB logging, Grafana monitoring
time_protocol.notes: Experiment ran from October 12, 2022 to approximately January 4, 2024 (449 days). Data logged with 2-second temporal resolution. Calendar aging cells recharged only if OCV deviates more than 5 mV from target voltage. Profile aging uses WLTP Class 3b driving cycle repeated until SoC falls below 10%.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Raw LOG dataset: 878 GB uncompressed, 55.7 GB compressed. Compact LOG_AGE dataset: 48.9 GB uncompressed, 5.1 GB compressed (30 s resolution for cyclic/calendar, 2 s for profile). Data gaps exist primarily in first two months due to Ethernet issues and power outages. Synthetic zero-current data points inserted at gap boundaries. NaN values documented in plausibility check spreadsheet.
rawdata.known_issues: Sporadic Ethernet failures in first two months causing data gaps. Three instances of power-cycling-induced flash data loss on cycler boards (slaves 6, 14, 16). Software bug caused incomplete PULSE data on SD card (resolved by using InfluxDB data). Temperature control issue Nov 27-29, 2022 (cold box dew point issue). One Peltier element failure in 25 C pool on April 23, 2023.

checkup.notes: First check-up at experiment start (Oct 12, 2022), second after 1 week, then every 3 weeks thereafter. Each check-up lasts approximately 1.5 days. Capacity check: CC-CV 1/3 C charge/discharge, 2.5-4.2 V, cutoff 1/20 C (0.15 A). EIS measured at RT (25 C) and operating temperature (OT) at 5 SoC points (10/30/50/70/90%) in ascending then descending order; frequency range 50 mHz to 14.7 kHz, amplitude +/-1/6 C (+/-0.5 A). Pulse pattern also applied at same SoC points; pulses of +/-1/3 C (+/-1.0 A) for 10 s with 60 s at +/-1/3 C. Check-up cutoff current: 1/20 C (0.15 A) for calendar cells, 1/10 C (0.3 A) for cyclic/profile cells.

notes: One of the largest published open-access battery aging datasets, containing over 3 billion data points from 228 NMC/C-SiO (LG INR18650HG2) cells aged for more than one year under 76 different operating conditions. Dataset includes both raw 2-second resolution log data and post-processed result data (EOC, EIS, PULSE). Cells submerged in silicone oil pools (Julabo Thermal H20S) for thermal management. Pool temperatures controlled to within +/-0.5 K of set point. Data hosted on RADAR4KIT repository (Karlsruhe Institute of Technology). Total download size: 69.4 GB. Published data covers 449 days (version 1). Companion paper DOI: 10.1038/s41597-024-03831-x. Example Python scripts available at https://github.com/energystatusdata/bat-age-data-scripts.
